# Discord as EMA Surface

## Main point
Discord should remain a first-class EMA interaction surface.

## Why
The old system proved Discord can carry:
- direct commands
- ambient ops
- fast human/agent interaction
- distributed work coordination
- swarm-style decomposition

## EMA role
Discord is not the whole product, but it is a real control, command, and conversational surface for EMA.
